paras.en: B. Put in semicolons, colons, dashes, quotation marks, italics (use an underline), and parentheses where ever they are needed in the following sentences.

Part A items 4–10 and Part B (thirteen sentences); all sentences are printed without the punctuation the student is asked to add (this is the exercise), so the Urdu and Pashto versions are likewise unpunctuated. A phone-number strip, the watermark, a coloured binding strip and the "Whatsapp" strip are excluded. Border lines and pink corner flags are excluded. The page number 201 is printed in a diamond at the foot.
